description: Classify request intent and route to the smallest applicable finance skill(s) with dependency order and missing inputs; does not execute finance tasks or claim nonexistent skills.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned source subtree copied verbatim; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json
provenance.license: MIT; exact original notice preserved in references/upstream/_licenses

routing.when_to_use: Use when a finance/CFO request is broad, ambiguous, or spans multiple finance tasks and the right task-specific workflow must be selected.
when_not_to_use: A different atomic task has its own skill
Requested output is an unapproved action or external effect
exclusion_rules: No system mutation or external communication
ambiguity_rules: Continue unaffected work and request only facts that materially change the result

required_inputs.name: scope_and_source_inputs
required_inputs.description: user request; current qualified skill catalog/readback; requested artifact/decision; entities/period; available evidence; owner and authorization context.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: matched skill ID(s), reason, chain/dependency order, required inputs, scope/authority flags and exact catalog gaps.

forbidden_actions: Mutation of company, fund, Odoo, accounting, payroll or source records
Payments, filings, signatures, publications, messages, approvals, trades or transaction commitments
Inventing current law, jurisdiction, entity/fund applicability or missing facts
verification_steps: 1. Parse desired output/verb, finance domain, entity, period, audience, urgency and any requested external effect. 2. Read the current qualified skill catalog; do not assume the source’ 35 third-party slug names exist in LiNKskills. Select only IDs that are actually available and qualified for this runtime. 3. Match the most specific atomic task (AP, AR, reconciliation, forecast, close, statements, fundraising, tax evidence, analysis, etc.). Keep reporting/decision preparation separate from posting, payment, filing and signing. 4. When a request spans jobs, split into a minimal ordered chain with explicit data handoffs; do not load five skills for a single-step request. 5. If two tasks match equally or a material scope/owner fact is missing, ask one targeted clarifying question or present options; routine routing needs no approval. 6. Check each selected skill’ dependencies/profile and status; draft/uncertified skills are not described as admitted or executable. If no qualified match exists, report the exact gap to the librarian, rather than inventing a tool/skill. 7. Return compact route plan with owner, inputs, evidence and boundary; wait for user’ task instruction before performing any work not already asked.
Show formulas/denominators, evidence dates and assumptions; preserve unresolved conflicts.
Write only a requested private draft; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Conditional task scope is evidenced or limitations explicitly bound
Task method and calculation are reproducible from cited inputs
Owner decisions, open issues and source limitations are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
